thread:
Maya S: Heads up — prod-us-east started dropping ~35% of requests at the ingress fast-path around :hourglass_flowing_sand:. Initial triage shows mismatched routing keys; some clients send X-Client-Region while our matcher expects X-Region. Planning a temporary header "massage" + TTL bypass toggle to restore routing until we roll a proper matcher fix. Will keep it scoped to prod-us-east and excluded for Dedicated pools.
Chris N: OK — agree on temporary header rewrite. Two quick asks: (1) set the KV cache TTL bypass to 1s to avoid stale prefix routing, (2) include an explicit exclusion for dedicated-customer tag so we don't affect reserved capacity. Also add a telemetry gate so we can measure header-mapped vs normal.
Lenka (oncall): +1 for the quick toggle. Make sure runbook link is in the change and add an alert if error rate doesn't drop in 5m. I'll standby for the flip.
Maya S: Plan: create toggle ingress.hdr-massage-v1 scoped to prod-us-east that rewrites X-Region <- X-Client-Region, set prefix cache bypass TTL=1s, rollout immediate. If errors drop, leave for 30m then revert and push proper routing matcher in next deploy. Command I'm going to run (dry-run first):
```
rdxctl routing toggle create ingress.hdr-massage-v1 --scope prod-us-east --rewrite 'X-Region:=X-Client-Region' --cache-bypass-ttl 1s --exclude-tag dedicated-customer
rdxctl routing toggle set ingress.hdr-massage-v1 --state on --dry-run
```
Devon R: Add one more exclusion: traffic with header X-Bypass-Routing=true should not be rewritten (we use that for traffic shaping tests). Also confirm this toggle doesn't increase tokenization or change request body.
Maya S: good catch, adding --exclude-header X-Bypass-Routing. Running dry-run now, will post output.
deploy-bot: change-request 1937002468 created by @Maya S: ingress.hdr-massage-v1 (scope=prod-us-east) — awaiting approvals: Lenka (oncall). Audit ID: cr-2026-03-18-422.
Lenka (oncall): approved — go for it. Make sure the alert mentioned earlier is pinned.
Maya S: Applying toggle (no traffic window scheduled, urgent patch).
```
rdxctl routing toggle set ingress.hdr-massage-v1 --state on --audit cr-2026-03-18-422
```
deploy-bot: toggle ingress.hdr-massage-v1 set to ON by @Maya S — effective immediately. Rollout id: roll-1937002474.
Maya S: Observing immediate effect: errors dropping from 35% -> 8% in 90s, p95 latency unchanged. Pushing a small metric slice:
- error_rate(prod-us-east) 15m: 0.35 -> 0.08
- header-mapped traffic: ~47% of ingress (these were the mismatched clients)
Chris N: Great. Keep TTL bypass at 1s for now. After 30m, if stable, do removal:
```
rdxctl routing toggle set ingress.hdr-massage-v1 --state off --audit cr-2026-03-18-422
```
and then follow with config PR to update the matcher to accept X-Client-Region permanently.
Maya S: Will monitor. I've added an alert: if error_rate doesn't drop below 10% within 5m of flip or if p50 latency increases >20% we rollback immediately. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/incident/runbooks/ingress-header-mismatch
Devon R: Noted. CI/infra please ensure Dedicated routing logs show no rewrite events.
Maya S: After 28m: traffic stable, errors at 6%, no Dedicated hits. Proceeding to schedule toggle off in 2m per plan and opening a config change PR for permanent matcher fix.
deploy-bot: scheduled action: toggle ingress.hdr-massage-v1 OFF at 1937003240 by @Maya S (auto).
Maya S: Toggling OFF now.
```
rdxctl routing toggle set ingress.hdr-massage-v1 --state off --audit cr-2026-03-18-422
```
deploy-bot: toggle ingress.hdr-massage-v1 set to OFF by @Maya S — rollback complete. Rollout id: roll-1937003251.
Maya S: Post-check: errors remain low (6-7%), no regressions, Dedicated unaffected. Created PR: https://repo.redwood/infra/merge_requests/3241 — matcher change to accept X-Client-Region and add tests. Tagging @Chris N for review.
Lenka (oncall): Thanks — marking incident as mitigated. Keep the thread for the config PR review. Good job everyone :thumbsup:
Chris N: I'll review the PR this afternoon. Suggest we add an integration test that simulates headers from older SDK versions.
Maya S: Agreed — adding tests to the PR. Closing this patch thread.
